sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static table requirement: it targets iceClassDesignParameterSet, traverses the required ship relationship to select the ice class without relocating or duplicating iceClass, applies upper bounds to levelIceThickness, exact inclusive bounds to designIceLoadHeight, and enforces metre units without inventing a datatype.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the candidate before freezing: remove the guessed xsd:decimal datatype from qudt:numericValue unless a verified canonical datatype explicitly declares it; the supplied canonical metadata leaves datatype unspecified. Also reconcile the target-owner structure: selection.requiredTargetOwner is iceClassDesignParameterSet, while the candidate targets nltl:ship for the complete requirement and places the ice-class check there. Preserve hasIceClassDesignParameterSet on the ship, but encode the requirement against the authoritative target owner and ensure each property is placed only on its declared requiredOwner; do not rely on the conflicting benchmarkEntity domain as a substitute.

Repair the table constraints before freezing. For each ice class, levelIceThickness (hi) is permitted not to exceed the tabulated value, so replace the exact-equality bounds with an upper-bound-only constraint (sh:maxInclusive 1.0, 0.8, 0.6, or 0.4 metres, respectively); do not require hi to equal the table value. Retain the exact inclusive bounds for designIceLoadHeight (h) at 0.35, 0.30, 0.25, and 0.22 metres. The parameter-set target and owner placement are otherwise aligned with the prior instruction, and the candidate correctly avoids an unverified numeric datatype.

Repair before freezing, preserving the earlier owner/target instruction: the complete requirement must target nltl:iceClassDesignParameterSet, not nltl:ship. Keep nltl:hasIceClassDesignParameterSet on the ship and keep nltl:iceClass on its authoritative ship owner, but validate the ice class from the parameter-set target by traversing the existing inverse relationship (^nltl:hasIceClassDesignParameterSet) rather than duplicating or relocating the fact. Retain levelIceThickness upper-bound-only constraints (1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4 m) and exact inclusive designIceLoadHeight bounds (0.35, 0.30, 0.25, 0.22 m); do not add an unverified datatype to qudt:numericValue.

Candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static table requirement: it targets iceClassDesignParameterSet, traverses the required ship relationship to select the ice class without relocating or duplicating iceClass, applies upper bounds to levelIceThickness, exact inclusive bounds to designIceLoadHeight, and enforces metre units without inventing a datatype.
